title: doing another round of testing for @conquest_online. Comment to Play Test. (a crossplay (PC/mobile) free-to-play MMORPG)
author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
selftext:
I have the dev link available for testing as I am still waiting to pay the pending invoice on this project :/

trying to gauge market interest

If you'd like to play test this build feel free to comment
